name: Docs
title: Blocks/Shell/Docs
summary: The documentation shell is `DocLayout`, composed once around the app's router view: this block's primary is the app's `App.vue` and every variant is a page body (an `<article>` only, with no header, rail, outline or footer of its own) that renders inside it. The layout owns the chrome and the DOCUMENT scrolls: a sticky docs header (the Azion Docs mark, the section links from `sections`, the search field that opens the ⌘K palette of every navigation page, and the `actions` slot with the GitHub `IconButton` and the Console `Button`), a sticky navigation rail from `lg` built from the `navigation` data (groups of rows with in-app `href`s followed with the router, inline subsections as `children`, the current row following the route) with the `ThemeSwitcher` in its `navigation-footer` slot and a drawer opened from the header below `lg`, the page in the layout's single main landmark, the sticky On this page rail from `xl` filled by the page itself (every `DocHeading` with an `anchor` at level 2 or 3 registers with the layout, in document order, and is tracked as the reader scrolls), the GitHub and Community `outline-groups` and a `DocCallToAction` in its `aside` slot (both shown only on pages with an outline), and the `Footer` (`variant="content"`) in the `footer` slot under the article, between the two rails; the primary's footer carries the columns, then one bottom bar with the brand and the social links at the start and the status and language at the end, stacked below `md`, in CSS. No page wraps its article in a scroll area, a full-height frame or a layout of its own. The primary's stand-in page, in its default slot, is a short guide (`DocPageHeader`, then `DocProse` with anchored `DocHeading` sections); replace it with `<RouterView />`. Five variants are page bodies built from the documentation parts only: Article is a tutorial (First deploy) with breadcrumb, last updated and meta actions, a `DocCardGroup` chooser of paths, `DocCallout` tips, `DocSteps` with `CodeBlock` commands, a `DocPrompt`, Next steps, Related resources as `DocItem` rows in a `RegistrationFrame`, and `DocPreviousNext`; Reference is a product reference page (an info callout, two actions, the request path as a `Diagram` in a `DocFrame`, a JSON `CodeBlock`, a term list); Landing is the documentation home, whose headings carry no anchor so no outline rail shows: a `DocHero` with `Get started` and the `CopyPromptButton`, a `DocAgentCard` above the Console, CLI and API `DocCard`s, objectives, ready-made templates in their brand colours, Stop attacks, compliance, Follow along and the pager forward; AgentSetup is the index of agent setup pages: a `Tabs` picker filtering `DocCard`s of coding agents by workflow, a comparison `DataTable` with check marks and `Tag`s, a legend `DocCallout` and a glossary of `DocCard` grids; AgentGuide is one agent's setup page: a masthead with the agent mark, fact `Tag`s and links, `DocSteps` with `DocCodeGroup` commands and `DocMarkdown` bodies, the MCP tools `DataTable`, CLI and context-file code, `DocItem` rows, `DocPrompt`s, tip callouts, FAQ and troubleshooting `DocAccordionGroup`s and the other agents grid.

variants.name: Article
variants.summary: A tutorial page body for the docs layout: masthead with breadcrumb and meta actions, a chooser of paths, callouts, steps with commands, an agent prompt, Next steps, Related resources and the pager; its anchored DocHeadings fill the layout's outline, with the GitHub and Community groups and a DocCallToAction under it.

variants.name: Reference
variants.summary: A product reference page body for the docs layout: an info callout, two actions, the request path as a Diagram in a DocFrame, a JSON CodeBlock, a term list and a two-column Next steps; its four anchored sections fill the layout's outline.

variants.name: Landing
variants.summary: The documentation home as a page body for the docs layout, with no outline (its headings carry no anchor): a DocHero with Get started and the CopyPromptButton (agent marks) and its note, then a DocAgentCard above the Console, CLI and API cards, then objectives, coloured framework templates, Stop attacks, compliance, Follow along and the pager forward.

variants.name: AgentSetup
variants.summary: The index of agent setup pages as a page body for the docs layout: a Tabs picker that filters the coding-agent DocCards by workflow, a comparison Table with check marks and Tags, a legend DocCallout, and Workflow, Key concepts and Common tradeoffs DocCard grids; its h2 and h3 sections fill the layout's outline.

variants.name: AgentGuide
variants.summary: One agent's setup page as a page body for the docs layout: a masthead with the agent mark, fact Tags and links, Quick start DocSteps with DocCodeGroup commands and DocMarkdown bodies, the MCP tools Table, CLI and CLAUDE.md code, agent-friendly DocItem rows, DocPrompts, tip callouts, FAQ and Troubleshooting DocAccordionGroups and the Other agents grid.
